name: zsnd_sample_play_a3d
description: zSndSample::PlayA3D gates initialized sound playback, queues stream groups, and starts 3D-capable sample playback through the active backend with global gain scaling.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage includes the no-position backend path, DirectSound and A3D world-position backend paths, and the createGuard stream-group queue path.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x49fcf0 validates the initialized/preinitialized/null-this guards, createGuard stream-group dispatch to QueueStreamRequestWithWorldPos, flag-0x08 sample playback gate, marker-base reset, global gain scaling, and PlayOnActiveBackend tail call.
The native smokes verify DirectSound and A3D backend playback through PlayA3D, global-gain scaling through the simple path, and stream-group request creation through the createGuard branch.
